name: Order of Aurelia
startIntroPart1: Thirty million people chose to stand together and build a nation of their own. Under King Lucian, the Order of Aurelia rose from that extraordinary bond with a simple purpose: to turn loyalty, knowledge, and organized effort into a civilization capable of shaping its own future.
startIntroPart2: King Lucian, will you guide Aurelia from its first foundations to a civilization that reaches beyond the limits of its world? Build a nation worthy of the people who entrusted their future to the Order, defend them when necessary, and carry the light of Aurelia into the ages to come.
declaringWar: You have chosen to threaten Aurelia. Very well. The Order will answer, and our people will stand together.
attacked: So be it. You have brought war to our doorstep. You will find Aurelia prepared.
defeated: The Order has fallen, but the people of Aurelia remain. What we built need not be forgotten.
denounced: We cannot overlook what you have done. The Order will remember this breach of trust.
neutralDenouncing: We cannot overlook what you have done. The Order will remember this breach of trust.
hateDenouncing: We cannot overlook what you have done. The Order will remember this breach of trust.
introduction: I am Lucian, first King of Aurelia. You stand before a nation built by those who chose to stand together. May we find reason to prosper beside one another.
neutralHello: Let us speak plainly and see whether our interests may coexist.
hateHello: Welcome. Let us hope your intentions toward Aurelia are peaceful.
tradeRequest: We have resources to spare, and interests that may complement your own. Shall we make an exchange?
declaringFriendship: Our peoples have found common ground. Let us preserve it, and build upon it.
neutralRejectingDemand: I would advise restraint. Aurelia seeks peace, but peace should never be mistaken for helplessness.
hateRejectingDemand: I would advise restraint. Aurelia seeks peace, but peace should never be mistaken for helplessness.
uniqueText: Many Hands, One Will: +50% Production while the empire is Happy. A Future Worth Building: completing any building grants 100 Science and 100 Culture.

civilopediaText.text: The Order of Aurelia was born from an extraordinary bond between thirty million people who chose to build a nation together. United by loyalty but free in their individual pursuits, they transformed their collective strength into a civilization devoted to prosperity, knowledge, and security. Under the guidance of King Lucian, the Order seeks not merely to survive, but to build a future worthy of those who entrusted it with their hopes.
